Which agencies handed out the most financial assistance in fiscal year 2020?

GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10

Which community water systems serve the most people?

SELECT pws_name, try_cast(population_served_count AS double) AS population_served_count FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the fair market rent for a two-bedroom home in Albany County, New York?

SELECT areaname, county_town_name, try_cast(fmr2 AS double) AS two_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE state_alpha = 'NY' AND countyname = 'Albany County' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
Which models have the most complaints that involved a crash?
SELECT concat(maketxt, ' ', modeltxt) AS model, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE crash = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did wind or nuclear plants generate more electricity in 2024?

SELECT CASE series_id WHEN 'ELEC.GEN.WND-US-99.A' THEN 'Wind' ELSE 'Nuclear' END AS source, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id IN ('ELEC.GEN.WND-US-99.A', 'ELEC.GEN.NUC-US-99.A') AND period = '2024'
Which wind farms in Iowa have the largest number of turbines?
SELECT p_name, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'IA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did total campaign operating spending change from the 2012 cycle to 2024?
SELECT cast(cycle AS varchar) AS year, sum(transaction_amt) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) IN ('2012', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which hospital outpatient services did Medicare patients receive most in 2023?
Medicare Outpatient Hospitals By Geography And Service

SELECT hcpcs_desc AS service, sum(try_cast(capc_srvcs AS double)) AS services FROM govblock_health.medicare_outpatient_hospitals_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file LIKE '%DY23%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average U.S. price of regular gasoline in the week of June 13, 2022?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_gallon FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.EMM_EPMR_PTE_NUS_DPG.W' AND period = '20220613'
Which Navy offices posted the most solicitations in 2024?
SELECT office, count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities WHERE subtier = 'DEPT OF THE NAVY' AND type = 'Solicitation' AND posteddate LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many figures does a granted patent include on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(num_figures AS double)), 1) AS avg_figures FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_figures
Which companies reported the most revenue for calendar 2023 in their SEC financial data?

SELECT entity_name, max(try_cast(val AS double)) AS revenue FROM govblock_sec.companyfacts WHERE concept IN ('Revenues', 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax') AND frame = 'CY2023' AND unit = 'USD' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were the Department of Education's net outlays for fiscal 2023?
SELECT try_cast(current_fytd_net_outly_amt AS double) AS net_outlays FROM govblock_treasury.mts_table_5 WHERE record_date = '2023-09-30' AND classification_desc = 'Total--Department of Education'
Which nuclear reactors have been in commercial operation the longest?
SELECT plant_name_unit_number AS reactor, commercial_operation FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 ORDER BY try_cast(commercial_operation AS date) ASC LIMIT 10
How did the number of utility patents granted change from 2000 to 2024?

SELECT substr(patent_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE patent_type = 'utility' AND substr(patent_date, 1, 4) IN ('2000', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which larger colleges admit the smallest share of applicants?

SELECT instnm, try_cast(adm_rate AS double) AS admission_rate FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE try_cast(adm_rate AS double) > 0 AND try_cast(ugds AS double) >= 1000 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many private foundations filed a 990-PF return for tax year 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT ein) AS foundations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_990_index WHERE return_type = '990PF' AND substr(cast(tax_period AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2022'
Which research awards listed in U.S. dollars are the largest?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(amount AS double) AS amount_usd FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_awards WHERE currency = 'USD' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did total U.S. energy consumption change from 1960 to 2023?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id = 'SEDS.TETCB.US.A' AND period IN ('1960', '2023') ORDER BY 1
Which California counties had the most fatal crashes in 2020?
SELECT countyname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'California' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest statewide load NYISO forecast for any hour of 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(nyiso AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_load_forecast_isolf WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2024'
Which states spend the most on Ozempic through Medicare Part D?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_state_abrvtn, sum(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double)) AS cost FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE brnd_name = 'Ozempic' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the share of patents with at least one woman inventor changed by grant year?

SELECT grant_year, round(100.0 * count_if(try_cast(women_inventors AS integer) > 0) / count(*), 1) AS pct_with_woman FROM govblock_patents.pv_annual WHERE cast(assignee_sequence AS varchar) = '0' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which journals have published the most articles?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_sources WHERE type = 'journal' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest yield at any 10-year note auction in 2023?
SELECT max(try_cast(high_yield AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_treasury.auctions_query WHERE security_term = '10-Year' AND security_type = 'Note' AND substr(auction_date, 1, 4) = '2023'
Which judges have been assigned the most patent cases?
SELECT assigned_to, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases WHERE coalesce(assigned_to, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many appeals arose from judgments entered in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.originating_court_information WHERE substr(cast(date_judgment AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024'
Which medical subject headings are used most often as a paper's major topic?
SELECT descriptor_name, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE major_topic = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many fatal crashes in 2022 involved a school bus?
SELECT count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND sch_bus = '1'
Which public universities charge out-of-state students the most in tuition and fees?
SELECT instnm, try_cast(tuitionfee_out AS double) AS out_of_state FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE cast(control AS varchar) = '1' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many people lived in Texas according to the 2024 one-year survey?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0400000US48' AND variable = 'B01003_E001'
Which New York school districts have the most students?

SELECT lea_name, try_cast(student_count AS double) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_lea_052 WHERE school_year = (SELECT max(school_year) FROM govblock_education.ccd_lea_052) AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' AND st = 'NY' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many households in Manhattan rent their home?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36061' AND variable = 'B25003_E003'
Which states spend the most on opioids through Medicare Part D?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_geo_desc AS state, round(sum(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double))) AS opioid_cost FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND opioid_drug_flag = 'Y' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemical reactions were extracted from U.S. patents granted in 2010?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE year = '2010'
Which cities of at least 50,000 people grew fastest in percentage terms from 2020 to 2025?

SELECT name, stname, round(100 * (try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) / try_cast(estimatesbase2020 AS double) - 1), 1) AS pct_growth FROM govblock_census.popest_sub_est WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '162' AND try_cast(estimatesbase2020 AS double) >= 50000 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many injuries have owners of the Tesla Model 3 reported in their complaints?
SELECT sum(try_cast(injured AS integer)) AS injured FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE maketxt = 'TESLA' AND modeltxt = 'MODEL 3'
Which state house districts have the most voting-age citizens?
Eligible Voters by State House District
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_sldlc WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the number of 13F holdings reports changed from year to year?
SELECT substr(periodofreport, 8, 4) AS year, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_submission WHERE submissiontype = '13F-HR' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which completed trials enrolled the most people?
SELECT nct_id, brief_title, enrollment FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE overall_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY try_cast(enrollment AS integer) DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Medicare pay the average cardiologist in the latest year?
Medicare Physician Other Practitioners By Provider

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(tot_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double))) AS avg_payment FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_provider WHERE source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_provider) AND rndrng_prvdr_type = 'Cardiology'
Which kinds of outside identifiers does PubChem record most often?
SELECT c2, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_identifiers WHERE c2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people lived in Brooklyn and worked in Manhattan in 2019?

SELECT sum(s000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_od WHERE state = 'ny' AND part = 'main' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 AND substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) = '36047' AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '36061'
Which solar panel makers appear most often in installed systems?
SELECT module_manufacturer_1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE module_manufacturer_1 <> '-1' AND module_manufacturer_1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the exact mass of sucrose, in daltons?
SELECT try_cast(c2 AS double) AS exact_mass FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c0 = '5988'
Which NSF directorates have awarded the most money overall?
SELECT longname, sum(try_cast(awardamount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do insiders hold the shares they trade directly or through trusts and other entities?

SELECT CASE direct_indirect_ownership WHEN 'D' THEN 'direct' WHEN 'I' THEN 'indirect' ELSE 'not stated' END AS ownership, count(*) AS transactions, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
